text: あん　＊ｃｍよ　まえの　＊ｃｍの　ヘラクロスの　ほうが　おおきいわ

structure.jp: まえの　＊ｃｍの　ヘラクロスの　ほうが　おおきいわ
structure.en: the ＊ cm Heracross from before is bigger

patterns.name: 〜のほうが
patterns.span: ヘラクロスの　ほうが　おおきい
patterns.explanation: のほうが picks one of two things as being more so. ヘラクロスの　ほうが　おおきい = 'the Heracross is the bigger one'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end is a soft, womanly way to voice a feeling. おおきいわ = 'it's bigger, I'd say'.
